tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Search JOA's live ledger of roughly 2.3M employer-direct job postings across 248 countries. Filter by country, city, US state, job category/family, seniority, remote type, employment type, source type, provider, employer (slug or verified domain), salary range, posting/verification date and free tex

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Fetch a single job posting's full detail: the complete advert description, per-field provenance (published/inferred/absent), and closure info if the role has since closed. NEEDS a JOA API key -- free Explore key at https://jobopportunitiesapi.org/login?ref=mcp. The description field is third-party t

tools.name: company_hiring
tools.description: Look up one employer by slug: its profile (website, industry, live open-role count) and its 30/90/365-day open-roles trend. The open-roles TREND works with NO key at all, mirroring this API's own keyless-statistics rule; the full profile, open-role count and optional live job rows need a JOA API key

tools.name: market_signals
tools.description: Aggregate, keyless market statistics: salary percentiles (p25/p50/p75, annualised EUR) and time-to-fill (days) by job family x country x seniority, plus listing/company/open/closed counts for that segment. Every percentile is suppressed (returned null, never a guess) below a minimum sample size -- n

tools.name: coverage
tools.description: Aggregate, keyless facts about the dataset itself: total live listings, employers with a live listing, per-source breakdown, and freshness (how recently every row was last re-confirmed live at its source). tools.name: changes_since
tools.description: The incremental change feed: every job created, updated, withdrawn or delisted since a given cursor, in change order, with a next_since cursor to resume from -- how an integrator keeps a local copy of the ledger current without re-scanning it.
